title: It takes 40 people to make one life look effortless
description: The staff of a large estate are a payroll, an org chart and a set of shifts. Their entire job is to leave no trace of themselves in the rooms the owner actually uses.

scenes.narration: It takes about forty people to make one life look effortless.
scenes.imagePrompt: A vast empty formal entrance hall of a country estate at dawn, marble floor polished to a mirror, one shaft of cold light falling from a tall window, deep shadow in the corners, no people

scenes.narration: None of them are visible when you walk in. That is the job.
scenes.imagePrompt: Narrow service corridor behind an estate kitchen, plain painted walls, a row of brass hooks, worn stone floor, warm low light fading into darkness, no people

scenes.narration: An estate manager runs the household the way a small company is run.
scenes.imagePrompt: An estate office at night, a large leather-topped desk with a single brass lamp lit, a wall of small brass key hooks receding into shadow, no people

scenes.narration: Below them, a chef, drivers, security, and a team of six who only handle the grounds.
scenes.imagePrompt: Rows of pressed white uniforms hanging in a dim staff cloakroom, plain garments on wooden hangers, one overhead bulb, deep shadow, no labels, no people

scenes.narration: Payroll on a large estate runs three million a year, before anyone buys anything.
scenes.imagePrompt: Professional estate kitchen at night, long steel counters gleaming, copper pans hanging on an overhead rack, spotless and completely empty, one lamp lit, no people

scenes.narration: Most of the work happens in rooms the owner never walks into.
scenes.imagePrompt: A dim laundry room in a large house, tall steel shelving stacked with folded white linen, one overhead lamp throwing long shadows, no people

scenes.narration: You are not paying for the house. You are paying for it to ask nothing of you.
scenes.imagePrompt: A formal dining room at night set for a single person, long polished table stretching away, one place setting lit by candlelight, tall dark windows behind, no people

scenes.narration: So the effortlessness was never a feature of the house. It was forty salaries.
scenes.imagePrompt: The same vast entrance hall at night, completely empty, a single lamp burning, marble floor holding its reflection, deep shadow filling the frame, no people
